title: Kaande Pohe
desc: Kaande Pohe - A Maharashtrian snack traditionally served when a boy visits a girls' family for the first time in an arranged marriage set up. The day is called 'Kaande Pohe Cha Kaaryakaram'. There is no data on this strategy's success rate. Meet Sanjay and Manisha who are on their 'Kaande Pohe Cha Kaaryakaram'.

title: Long Drive
desc: Vikram, Zain and Aman are on a long drive together. But when Vikram takes an unexpected turn, his friends aren’t sure what to expect. Will they make it back in time? And does Vikram have something on his mind? Watch Long Drive to find out.

title: Make Her Happy
desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

title: Aakhri Sawari
desc: Manish, a perfect husband and father, tormented by a mysterious parcel he receives from an anonymous sender has to make a life-changing decision. He shares his problems with his cab driver who listens patiently and tries to help. What the cab driver offers changes both of their lives forever.

title: Barat
desc: A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!

title: El'ayichi
desc: What happens when you have a dead but clingy husband, an irritated wife, and a fossilized dodo in the same house? Experience love, way past its 'expiry' date.

title: Haba Goba
desc: Getting intimate takes a lot of planning in "these times". Nandini and Kush have done all that and more for their "special" date. But will things go as smoothly as planned? Or will there be bumps along the way?

title: Pilibhit
desc: Inspired by true stories, Siraj, a righteous, impoverished flute maker, resides at the edge of the forests of Pilibhit, North India, where man-eating tigers thrive. His mounting livelihood pressures and tragedies corner him to take a drastic measure that threatens to tear down his values and a loved one.

title: Mamta Tonic
desc: A travelling saleswoman. 3 potential customers. She weighs the pros of her homemade tonic against the cons of making tough choices in life.

title: Kheer
desc: As we age, life can get lonelier and the definition of relationships, mature. Kheer is a delightful serving of love and companionship where secrets get accidentally spilt and shared.

title: Do Cutting
desc: An unforgettable love story about how a couple due to societal pressures on inter religion marriages hold up their lives.

title: A Tale Of An Onion Witch
desc: Two flatmates, evidently from the gym-going North Indian breed of tinsel-town hopefuls, are warned about the 100 year old Witch that occasionally wanders around at night asking for an Onion. When an attractive neighbour knocks for help at midnight, their red-blooded fates unravel.

title: Panic
desc: A riveting psychological thriller that propels an aspiring actor's life into chaos when a toothache triggers an unfounded belief in oral cancer, setting off a catastrophic chain of events.

title: Alvida
desc: Break-ups can be hard, but sometimes they are necessary. Sometimes, you need all your strength to let go and say ... Alvida.

title: An Astrologer's Day
desc: Based on a short story by R.K. Narayan from Malgudi Days. A normal day in the life of an astrologer reveals a lot about him.

title: Bena
desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

title: Deuce
desc: A mother and a son argue about love, insecurities and acceptance around an intense match of table tennis. Who wins? Who loses? Watch Deuce.

title: Eelu Rani Bhag Gaye
desc: Two teenagers running away from their home comes across a police officer who persuades them not to go, however Eelu & Rani have something else on their mind.

title: Jai Mata Di
desc: Mumbai is a funny city. Call it a melting pot, the glamour capital, or simply the most open and safe place to be around. But when it comes to two people living under the same roof without a marriage certificate, it’s not religion, caste, or even the parents that’s the biggest hurdle. It’s a species that dictates the law of the land without really owning it. The Society Secretary. But as they say, there’s nothing mom can’t solve. With that belief on the one hand, and a funny bone in the other, we say Jai Mata Di!

title: L
desc: A mother's dream of riding a scooter is not as easy as it seems.

title: Naamkaran
desc: When it comes to new beginnings, families have a way of always being there. Sometimes it's as simple as a good- morning forward. But for Jay, it's something slightly more dramatic. Watch Naamkaran, as Jay and his (uninvited) family take on a new challenge.

title: Bhagwaan - The Faith
desc: A final chance meeting with a mysterious old homeless man changes everything they’ve experienced that day. The story delves into how deep their faith truly is and how people worship gods. Some use faith and god as a means of solace while others as a crutch for a troubling life.
